```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(mlbench)
```

```{r}
data(BostonHousing2)
BostonHousing2<- BostonHousing2 |> 
  st_transform(4326)
```

```{r}
 pal <- colorNumeric(palette = "YlOrRd", 
                    domain = BostonHousing2$cmedv,
                    reverse = TRUE)
)
```

```{r}

leaflet () |>
  setView(lat= 42.2875, lng= -70.9500 , zoom= 7) |>
  addProviderTiles("OpenStreetMap")|>
  addCircleMarkers(data= BostonHousing2,
                   fillColor = ~pal(cmedv),
                   stroke = T)
  
```
